title: False Prophets and Teachers

questions.question: But false prophets also arose among the people, just as there will be false ____ among you,
questions.explanation: 2 Peter 2:1 (ESV): "But false prophets also arose among the people, just as there will be false teachers among you, who will secretly bring in destructive heresies, even denying the Master who bought them, bringing upon themselves swift destruction."

questions.question: who will secretly bring in destructive heresies, even denying the ____ who bought them, bringing upon themselves swift destruction.
questions.explanation: 2 Peter 2:1 (ESV): "...who will secretly bring in destructive heresies, even denying the Master who bought them, bringing upon themselves swift destruction."

questions.question: And many will follow their ____, and because of them the way of truth will be blasphemed.
questions.explanation: 2 Peter 2:2 (ESV): "And many will follow their sensuality, and because of them the way of truth will be blasphemed."

questions.question: And in their ____ they will exploit you with false words. Their condemnation from long ago is not idle, and their destruction is not asleep.
questions.explanation: 2 Peter 2:3 (ESV): "And in their greed they will exploit you with false words. Their condemnation from long ago is not idle, and their destruction is not asleep."

questions.question: For if God did not spare angels when they sinned, but cast them into ____ and committed them to chains of gloomy darkness to be kept until the judgment;
questions.explanation: 2 Peter 2:4 (ESV): "For if God did not spare angels when they sinned, but cast them into hell and committed them to chains of gloomy darkness to be kept until the judgment;"

questions.question: if he did not spare the ancient world, but preserved ____, a herald of righteousness, with seven others, when he brought a flood upon the world of the ungodly;
questions.explanation: 2 Peter 2:5 (ESV): "if he did not spare the ancient world, but preserved Noah, a herald of righteousness, with seven others, when he brought a flood upon the world of the ungodly;"

questions.question: if by turning the cities of Sodom and ____ to ashes he condemned them to extinction, making them an example of what is going to happen to the ungodly;
questions.explanation: 2 Peter 2:6 (ESV): "if by turning the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah to ashes he condemned them to extinction, making them an example of what is going to happen to the ungodly;"

questions.question: and if he rescued righteous ____, greatly distressed by the sensual conduct of the wicked...
questions.explanation: 2 Peter 2:7 (ESV): "and if he rescued righteous Lot, greatly distressed by the sensual conduct of the wicked"

questions.question: then the Lord knows how to rescue the ____ from trials, and to keep the unrighteous under punishment until the day of judgment,
questions.explanation: 2 Peter 2:9 (ESV): "then the Lord knows how to rescue the godly from trials, and to keep the unrighteous under punishment until the day of judgment,"

questions.question: and especially those who indulge in the lust of defiling passion and despise ____. Bold and willful, they are not afraid to blaspheme the glorious ones,
questions.explanation: 2 Peter 2:10 (ESV): "and especially those who indulge in the lust of defiling passion and despise authority. Bold and willful, they are not afraid to blaspheme the glorious ones,"

questions.question: Forsaking the right way, they have gone astray. They have followed the way of ____, the son of Beor, who loved gain from wrongdoing,
questions.explanation: 2 Peter 2:15 (ESV): "Forsaking the right way, they have gone astray. They have followed the way of Balaam, the son of Beor, who loved gain from wrongdoing,"

questions.question: but was rebuked for his own transgression; a speechless ____ spoke with human voice and restrained the prophet's madness.
questions.explanation: 2 Peter 2:16 (ESV): "but was rebuked for his own transgression; a speechless donkey spoke with human voice and restrained the prophet's madness."

questions.question: These are waterless ____, mists driven by a storm. For them the gloom of utter darkness has been reserved.
questions.explanation: 2 Peter 2:17 (ESV): "These are waterless springs, mists driven by a storm. For them the gloom of utter darkness has been reserved."

questions.question: They promise them ____, but they themselves are slaves of corruption. For whatever overcomes a person, to that he is enslaved.
questions.explanation: 2 Peter 2:19 (ESV): "They promise them freedom, but they themselves are slaves of corruption. For whatever overcomes a person, to that he is enslaved."

questions.question: It has happened to them according to the true proverb, "The ____ returns to its own vomit, and the sow, after washing herself, returns to wallow in the mire."
questions.explanation: 2 Peter 2:22 (ESV): "It has happened to them according to the true proverb, 'The dog returns to its own vomit, and the sow, after washing herself, returns to wallow in the mire.'"

key_verse_text: then the Lord knows how to rescue the godly from trials, and to keep the unrighteous under punishment until the day of judgment,
